findings.finding: Two dependency tests were stale after production correctly required external command authority and the successor public parser removed the legacy line-cap route. The accepted lease amendment corrected only test-fixture semantics; no production change was indicated.

Independent fresh-target review exposed exit 101 because the unit test's command launcher fell back to the current lib-test executable when neither CARGO_BIN_EXE_ultragoal nor an adjacent target/debug/ultragoal existed. A reused target had masked this with a stale adjacent binary and exit 2. The corrected control never launches an opportunistically discovered executable: it tests replay rejection directly and the production parser's exact typed refusal, with repeated no-panic and zero-write checks.

The process tests use Cargo's current binary in isolated repositories. They do not prove package installation, supported-host runtime identity, effectful command groups, or the complete representative product journey matrix.
